_note: Assumed inputs and schemas for 7.3. Paths are {key: path_for key, rel: relative path}. Edit freely. Build agent, 2026-11-05.
_tile_note: one tile per 375 m block keeps split purity. The framework said 256 m tiles

split_future.schema: P1 wellsight.cv_splits.v1. tasks.<task>.folds.<fold> = {train, inner_val, held_out}. Read with ek.read_split(split_task)
split_future._task_note: Release roles come from the P1 pit folds, as the provisional release uses the pit historical split. Pad baselines stay out-of-fold through their own split file.

audit_blocks.schema: P2 commented CSV with .sha256 sidecar. role audit = sealed hidden test, buffer = excluded from both. Read with ek.require_audit

split_historical.schema: fold int, role in {held_out, ...}, block_id int

baselines._note: Each baseline is clipped per block from the fold raster of the fold that held that block out, read from the model's own split file. Pit and pad folds differ (protocol section 8)

scorer._policy_note: Cutoff, minimum area, IoU, match order, blob score and K come only from expkit.policy_for(task) (review F02 / 7.3-01, 2026-11-06). Primary pit 0.35 and pad 0.525. 0.10 is the sensitivity mode only. The export stamps the policy into the release as scoring_policy.json. Never tune these on the dev test.

leaderboard._margin_note: 2026-11-06. User accepted the default 0.03 recall (take defaults). An entry beats the baseline when its paired difference lower bound exceeds the margin. Change freely. Never seed spread.
leaderboard._h3_note: user decision, still open (2026-11-06). Null keeps the H3 decision pending. The framework rule 2 x margin is reported for reference only
leaderboard.multiplicity: holm over declared primaries. The leaderboard gate is one primary per entry (difference from the U-Net baseline). H1 H2 H3 are validity checks, not gated by Holm (user default 2026-11-06)
